config.route:
- route:
    from:
      uri: direct:partner-agg3
      steps:
        - choice:
            when:
                - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'INQUIRY'"
                  steps:
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=INQUIRY.request"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-soap-call?address=http://mw-simulators:8080/agg3/v1/soap&request=json&response=json&namespace=urn:agg3:v1&soapAction=urn:agg3:v1:GetBill&wsUsername=bits&wsPasswordSecret=ws-password"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=INQUIRY.response&definiteStatuses=200"
                - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'PAY'"
                  steps:
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=PAY.request"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-soap-call?address=http://mw-simulators:8080/agg3/v1/soap&request=json&response=json&namespace=urn:agg3:v1&soapAction=urn:agg3:v1:PayBill&wsUsername=bits&wsPasswordSecret=ws-password"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=PAY.response&definiteStatuses=200&pending=true"
                - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'STATUS_QUERY'"
                  steps:
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=STATUS_QUERY.request"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-soap-call?address=http://mw-simulators:8080/agg3/v1/soap&request=json&response=json&namespace=urn:agg3:v1&soapAction=urn:agg3:v1:PaymentStatus&wsUsername=bits&wsPasswordSecret=ws-password"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=STATUS_QUERY.response&definiteStatuses=200&pending=true"
                - simple: "${header.mwOperation} == 'REVERSE'"
                  steps:
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-map?mapping=REVERSE.request"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-soap-call?address=http://mw-simulators:8080/agg3/v1/soap&request=json&response=json&namespace=urn:agg3:v1&soapAction=urn:agg3:v1:ReversePayment&wsUsername=bits&wsPasswordSecret=ws-password"
                    - to: "kamelet:mw-classify?mapping=REVERSE.response&definiteStatuses=200"
        - to: "kamelet:mw-audit"
